items.stem: You must apply the same heading format throughout a 40-page document and update it later in one step. What should you use?

options.rationale: Correct: paragraph styles apply and update formatting consistently in one place.
Manual formatting cannot be updated globally in one step.

options.text: A new master page per heading
options.rationale: Master pages govern layout furniture, not run-in text formatting.
Splitting documents does not solve consistent text styling.

items.explanation: Correct: paragraph styles apply and update formatting consistently in one place.

items.stem: What is the purpose of running preflight before export?

options.text: To detect problems such as missing links, fonts and low-resolution images
options.rationale: Correct: preflight flags production issues before output.

options.text: To automatically write the article content
options.rationale: Preflight checks production readiness, not content authoring.

options.text: To change the document to RGB for print
options.rationale: Preflight does not convert colour; print generally needs CMYK.
That is housekeeping, not what preflight does.

items.explanation: Correct: preflight flags production issues before output.

items.stem: Which TWO are good reasons to use master pages?

options.text: Consistent headers, footers and page numbers across pages
options.rationale: Correct: master pages place repeating elements consistently.

options.text: Update a repeating element everywhere by editing it once
options.rationale: Correct: editing the master updates all pages using it.
Master pages do not store exports.

options.text: Replace the need for paragraph styles
options.rationale: Master pages handle layout furniture, not text styles.

items.explanation: Correct: master pages place repeating elements consistently.
